correctness.rationale: The displayed triangle u has sum zero, squared radii (49,169,289), and βj−3=|uj|², so z=e^(−3iγt)u solves the full nonlinear system for all real γ. In rotating coordinates, the full 6-real Jacobian blocks are [[1,−γ],[γ,1]]−2δjk UjUjᵀ. Independent symbolic computation reconstructs det(λI−J)=λqγ(λ) with the specified quintic, including linear γ² coefficients and positive qγ(0). Its leading Routh–Hurwitz minors Δ1,Δ2,Δ3 are strictly positive, Δ4=12F(γ²), Δ5=341713944(1+γ²)F(γ²); F has positive derivative for X≥0 and opposite signs at 112,113. Two right-half-plane roots below threshold and zero above follow from Routh signs. At F=0 auxiliary quadratic yields simple imaginary pair with remaining Hurwitz cubic; simple Δ4 zero yields transverse crossing. Directly recomputed numerical root counts near both sides corroborate, not prove, the global spectral claim.
